name: Serverless REST API
description: HTTP API (API Gateway v2) in front of a Node.js Lambda that creates, lists and reads items in a DynamoDB table through the AWS SDK.

name: Queue worker
description: SQS queue with a dead-letter queue and a Lambda consumer that processes messages in batches and reports partial failures.

name: Event fan-out
description: SNS topic that fans every message out to two SQS queues (billing and shipping) with least-privilege queue policies.

name: Static website
description: S3 bucket configured for static website hosting with a public-read policy, an index page and an error page.

name: Scheduled job
description: EventBridge Scheduler invoking a Lambda function on a rate expression through a dedicated scheduler role.

name: VPC basics
description: VPC with two public subnets in different availability zones, an internet gateway, a public route table and a web security group.

name: Step Functions workflow
description: Step Functions state machine that invokes a Lambda task, waits, and branches on the result.

name: Pub/Sub and Cloud Storage
description: Pub/Sub topic with a pull subscription and dead-letter topic, plus a Cloud Storage bucket for message archives.

name: Storage account with queue
description: Resource group with a storage account, a private blob container and a storage queue.

name: Object Storage bucket
description: OCI Object Storage bucket in a compartment, with the namespace looked up automatically.
